fusions.name: Sunlit Ambush
fusions.desc: A strike from total stillness that deals 28 damage, is always a critical hit and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tail Lash
fusions.desc: Whips the haft around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, at a cost of 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Drop the Tail
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Warm Stones
fusions.desc: In daylight, your damage rises by 10%.
